Agent instructions

Agent rules

The standard every repository here follows is not copied into it. Each agent loads it from its own global file, kept current from one source:

Agent Global file
Claude ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, which imports ~/.claude/workspace-standard.md
Codex ~/.codex/AGENTS.md
Grok ~/.grok/AGENTS.md
Antigravity the workspace-rules plugin

The standing rulebook is ~/repos/RULES.md. If none of these loaded, read ~/.claude/workspace-standard.md and ~/repos/RULES.md before acting.

secure-code-agent

Rendered from AGENTS.md in the secure-code-agent repository. The markdown is the source of truth.
